scope: Android port: design, core port with C# parity fixtures, preview build on the tablet

hypothesis.claim: A pure Kotlin core reproduces every Windows analytic, report and protocol result exactly, so the Android platform layer only supplies data
hypothesis.disconfirming_result: Any parity fixture differs, or core needs Android APIs

options: Native Kotlin + Compose with JVM core
decision.chosen: Native Kotlin + Compose with JVM core
decision.why: Owner choice; Wi-Fi APIs and lifecycle are native; core testable without a device

change.summary: core module (domain, analytics, selection, runtime, responder, report, api, ie, net, forms), C# fixture generator, preview app, UX spec, parity matrix
change.scope_authority: Owner 2026-10-19: create the Android APK, all features one for one

regression: Windows suite unaffected (fixture test is explicit)

what_worked: C#-generated fixtures with exact JSON-tree comparison
what_failed: lazy LINQ in the fixture generator (fixed)
residual_risk: Platform layer and screens not built

reuse.reuse_applied: Windows analytics and protocols ported unchanged; reference export/UX lessons

lessons.transferable_rule: Let the source implementation generate parity answers and snapshot them eagerly

next_action.action: Build the Android platform layer and screens
